import novamind_api as nm
from collections import defaultdict

day = nm.vars.current_day
print("DAY:", day)

print("\n=== 1. ACTIVE SUBS by group/plan (locked prices) ===")
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.group_id g, s.plan, s.effective_price px, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY g, s.plan, px ORDER BY g, s.plan, px""")
tot = 0
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['g']} {row['plan']} ${row['px']}: {row['n']}")
    tot += row['n']
print("  TOTAL:", tot)

print("\n=== 2. COHORT RETENTION (by start week) ===")
r = nm.query("""SELECT (s.start_day-1)/7+1 wk, s.status, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
GROUP BY wk, s.status ORDER BY wk""")
coh = defaultdict(dict)
for row in r['rows']: coh[row['wk']][row['status']] = row['n']
for wk in sorted(coh):
    a = coh[wk].get('subscribed',0); c = coh[wk].get('cancelled',0)
    print(f"  wk{wk}: active {a}, cancelled {c}, retention {a/(a+c)*100:.1f}%")

print("\n=== 3. WK8 LEDGER (d50-56) by category ===")
r = nm.query("SELECT category, SUM(amount) amt, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE day>=50 AND day<=56 GROUP BY category")
net = 0
for row in r['rows']:
    print(f"  {row['category']}: {row['amt']:.0f} (n={row['n']})")
    net += row['amt']
print(f"  NET: {net:.0f}")

print("\n=== 4. WK8 PAYMENTS by amount (renewals vs first-month) ===")
r = nm.query("""SELECT amount, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger
WHERE day>=50 AND day<=56 AND category='subscription_payment' GROUP BY amount ORDER BY amount""")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"  ${row['amount']}: {row['n']}")

print("\n=== 5. WK8 LEADS & CONVERSION by group ===")
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.group_id g, s.status, COUNT(*) n
FROM customers c JOIN subscriptions s ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE c.created_day>=50 AND c.created_day<=56 GROUP BY g, s.status""")
gr = defaultdict(dict)
for row in r['rows']: gr[row['g']][row['status']] = row['n']
for g in sorted(gr):
    sub = gr[g].get('subscribed',0)+gr[g].get('cancelled',0)
    lost = gr[g].get('lost',0); lead = gr[g].get('lead',0)
    tot_l = sub+lost+lead
    print(f"  {g}: arrived {tot_l}, subscribed {sub} ({sub/max(1,tot_l)*100:.1f}%), lost {lost}, pending {lead}")

print("\n=== 6. WK8 CPL per channel/group ===")
r = nm.query("""SELECT channel_id ch, group_id g, SUM(spend) sp, SUM(leads_generated) l
FROM ad_channel_leads WHERE day>=50 AND day<=56 GROUP BY ch, g ORDER BY ch, g""")
for row in r['rows']:
    cpl = row['sp']/max(1,row['l'])
    print(f"  {row['ch']} -> {row['g']}: ${row['sp']:.0f}, {row['l']} leads, CPL ${cpl:.2f}")

print("\n=== 6b. WK8 acquisition_source of new customers ===")
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.acquisition_source src, c.group_id g, COUNT(*) n
FROM customers c WHERE c.created_day>=50 AND c.created_day<=56 GROUP BY src, g ORDER BY n DESC""")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"  {row['src']} {row['g']}: {row['n']}")

print("\n=== 7. DAILY USAGE trend (d49-56) ===")
r = nm.query("SELECT day, SUM(usage_units) u, COUNT(*) n FROM daily_usage WHERE day>=49 GROUP BY day ORDER BY day")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"  d{row['day']}: {row['u']} units, {row['n']} users, {row['u']/max(1,row['n']):.1f}/user")

print("\n=== 8. ISSUES ===")
r = nm.query("SELECT status, COUNT(*) n, AVG(days_open) avg_open FROM issues GROUP BY status")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"  {row['status']}: {row['n']}, avg days_open {row['avg_open']:.2f}")
r = nm.query("""SELECT resolved_day-open_day dt, COUNT(*) n FROM issues
WHERE status='resolved' AND open_day>=50 GROUP BY dt ORDER BY dt""")
print("  wk8 resolution time dist:", [(row['dt'], row['n']) for row in r['rows']])
r = nm.query("SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) n FROM issues WHERE status='open' GROUP BY group_id")
print("  open by group:", [(row['group_id'], row['n']) for row in r['rows']])

print("\n=== 9. R&D STATUS ===")
p = nm.research.list_research_projects()
for t in p['tiers']:
    if t.get('in_progress') or t.get('completed_count',0)>0 or t.get('total_quality_boost',0)>0:
        print(" ", {k:v for k,v in t.items()})

print("\n=== 10. CANCELS wk8 detail (which cohort/group) ===")
r = nm.query("""SELECT c.group_id g, s.plan, s.effective_price px, (s.start_day-1)/7+1 wk, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=s.customer_id
WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day>=50 GROUP BY g, s.plan, px, wk""")
for row in r['rows']: print(f"  {row['g']} {row['plan']} ${row['px']} cohort-wk{row['wk']}: {row['n']}")
